versions.content: Communication Management shall provide an interface to pro- vide methods to other applications Description: Application developers shall be able to provide methods which can be called by other applications. Rationale: After offering a service, it shall be possible for other applications to call methods of the service and get the respective result. Dependencies: – Use Case: Application “A” calls the “getCurrentTime” method of the wall clock service provided by application “B”.
